title: SelectTopicHttpRequestV3
description: Request body for PUT /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/selected-topic. Persists the selected-topic pair on the project. Backend validates ownership, currency, and uniqueness of the requested idea_id.

topic_ideas_artifact_id.description: The artifact_id of the active Topic Ideas artifact for this project.

idea_id.description: Backend-assigned idea ID to select. Must appear exactly once in the topic ideas artifact.
